keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Alan Vega (Club Tijuana).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Unai Bilbao replaces Alan Vega because of an injury.
Alejandro Gómez (Club Tijuana) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Martín Sarrafiore (Atlante).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Unai Bilbao (Club Tijuana) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Iván Tona (Club Tijuana) is shown the yellow card.
Gilberto Adame (Atlante) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Club Tijuana 0, Atlante 0.
Substitution, Atlante. Daniel González replaces Gilberto Adame.
Substitution, Atlante. Cristóbal Alfaro replaces Diogo Bagüí.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Elias Manoel replaces Mourad El Ghezouani.
Second Half begins Club Tijuana 0, Atlante 0.
Substitution, Atlante. Joaquín Moxica replaces Luis Puente.
Daniel González (Atlante) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atlante. Octavio Vázquez replaces Luis Calzadilla.
Gustavo Sánchez (Atlante) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Club Tijuana 1, Atlante 0. Gilberto Mora (Club Tijuana) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
Martín Sarrafiore (Atlante) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Ignacio Rivero (Club Tijuana).
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Pablo Ortíz replaces Gilberto Mora.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Atlante. Jairón Charcopa replaces Jhojan Julio.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Ramiro Árciga replaces Francisco González.
